name: Dask Open-Source Parallel Analytics (Local)
free_limit: BSD-3-Clause open-source Python library for local parallel DataFrame, array and task-graph computation; no software license fee or per-job vendor quota.
watch_out: Local execution uses your own CPU, RAM and disk. Optional distributed scheduler and cloud/Kubernetes clusters require self-provided infrastructure and may incur compute, storage and network charges; no hosted free cluster is included. BSD-3-Clause notices apply.
